'''Business and economy'''
*[[President of Iran|Iranian President]] [[Hassan Rouhani]] announces that all [[cryptocurrency mining]] will be banned in the country until September 22, blaming illegal mining for causing a recent series of [[power outage]]s. [https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2021/5/26/iran-bans-all-crypto-mining-after-summer-power-cuts-strike (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*Four people are confirmed dead and 156 more are reported missing after a ferry traveling between [[Niger State]] and [[Kebbi State|Kebbi]], [[Nigeria]], sinks in the [[Niger River]]. [https://today.rtl.lu/news/world/a/1728533.html (RTL)]

'''Health and environment'''
*[[COVID-19 pandemic]]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Asia]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Malaysia]]
****[[Malaysia]] reports a record 7,478 new cases and 63 deaths from [[COVID-19]] in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide total of confirmed cases to 533,367 and the nationwide death toll to 2,432. [https://www.freemalaysiatoday.com/category/nation/2021/05/26/record-high-7478-covid-19-cases/ (Free Malaysia Today)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in the Maldives]]
****The [[Maldives]] imposes a curfew from 4:00 p.m. until 8:00 a.m. and will only allow people to travel for a few hours each day to obtain essential supplies in order to reduce the number of COVID-19 cases. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/maldives-imposes-strict-curbs-covid-19-cases-spike-2021-05-26/ (Reuters)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Taiwan]]
****[[Taiwan]] reports a record 11 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 46. [https://amp.scmp.com/news/china/science/article/3134880/coronavirus-taiwan-seeks-300-missing-covid-positive-people-635 (''South China Morning Post'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Thailand]]
****[[Thailand]] reports a record 41 deaths from COVID-19 in the past 24 hours, thereby bringing the nationwide death toll to 873. [https://www.bangkokpost.com/thailand/general/2121903/41-covid-deaths-in-24-hours-new-record-high (''Bangkok Post'')]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Europe]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Belgium]]
****[[Belgium]] suspends the use of the [[Johnson & Johnson COVID-19 vaccine]] for people under the age of 41 following the death of a woman who had received the [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] last week and who was showing "serious [[thrombosis]] and reduced blood platelets". [https://abcnews.go.com/Health/wireStory/belgium-suspends-jj-vaccine-41s-death-77913484 (ABC News)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Cyprus]]
****The [[Cyprus|Cypriot]] [[List of Ministers of Health of the Republic of Cyprus|Ministry of Health]] issues a new recommendation that people under the age of 50 should not receive the [[Oxford–AstraZeneca COVID-19 vaccine|Oxford–AstraZeneca]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]] and should receive an [[Messenger RNA|mRNA]] vaccine instead. However, people under the age of 50 who have already received their first dose of the AstraZeneca vaccine should proceed normally with the second dose. [https://cyprus-mail.com/2021/05/26/coronavirus-az-for-under-50s-not-recommended-new-guidelines/ (''Cyprus Mail'')]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Slovakia]]
****[[Slovakia]] authorizes the use of the [[Russia]]n [[Sputnik V COVID-19 vaccine|Sputnik V]] [[COVID-19 vaccine|vaccine]], becoming the second [[European Union]] country to do so after [[Hungary]]. [https://apnews.com/article/russia-europe-slovakia-coronavirus-pandemic-government-and-politics-009327bd95f9ecbbe62ee73d45aafa73 (AP)]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Switzerland]]
****The [[Switzerland|Swiss]] [[Government of Switzerland|government]] announces that indoor restaurants will be reopened and people will no longer be required to [[work from home]] beginning May 31 as the number of COVID-19 cases continues to decline. [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20210526-swiss-reopen-indoor-dining-as-covid-measures-eased (France 24)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in the United States]]
***[[COVID-19 pandemic in Pennsylvania]], [[COVID-19 vaccine]]
****[[Pennsylvania]] becomes the 10th [[U.S. state]] to reach [[President of the United States|President]] [[Joe Biden]]’s goal of vaccinating 70% of adults. [https://thehill.com/homenews/state-watch/555579-pennsylvania-becomes-10th-state-to-hit-bidens-vaccine-goal (''The Hill'')]
***[[President of the United States|U.S. President]] [[Joe Biden]] orders [[United States Intelligence Community|intelligence agencies]] to increase their investigations into the [[Investigations into the origin of COVID-19|origin of the virus]], following reports that researchers at the [[Wuhan Institute of Virology]] became ill a month before the pandemic began. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/26/biden-orders-review-of-us-intel-on-origins-of-coronavirus (Al Jazeera)]
**[[COVID-19 pandemic in Namibia]]
***President [[Hage Geingob]] and his wife [[Monica Geingos|Monica]] test positive for COVID-19. [http://www.xinhuanet.com/english/africa/2021-05/27/c_139973184.htm (Xinhuanet)]

'''International relations'''
*[[Ireland–Israel relations]], [[Ireland–Palestine relations]]
**The [[Dáil Éireann]] unanimously passes a motion introduced by the oppositional [[Sinn Féin]] condemning the [[Israeli settlement]]s as representing a ''de facto'' annexation of [[State of Palestine|Palestinian]] land, making [[Republic of Ireland|Ireland]] the first [[European Union]] member to make such a condemnation. Yesterday, [[Department of Foreign Affairs (Ireland)|Foreign Affairs Minister]] [[Simon Coveney]] called for the [[Government of the 33rd Dáil|government]] to adopt the motion. However, an amendment calling for the Israeli ambassador to be expelled and for sanctions to be placed on [[Israel]] was rejected by a vote of 87–43. [https://www.rte.ie/news/politics/2021/0526/1224126-politics-dail-motion/ (RTÉ)]
*[[Switzerland–European Union relations]]
**[[President of the Swiss Confederation|Swiss President]] [[Guy Parmelin]] announces that [[Switzerland|his country]] has broken off talks with the European Union over a possible framework agreement, highlighting impasses on the issues of [[State aid (European Union)|state aid]], wage protections, and [[Citizens' Rights Directive|freedom of movement]]. [https://www.france24.com/en/europe/20210526-switzerland-ends-talks-with-eu-on-co-operation-agreement (France 24)]
*Qatari Foreign Minister [[Mohammed bin Abdulrahman bin Jassim Al Thani]] pledges [[United States dollar|US$]]500 million to help rebuild the [[Gaza Strip]] following the cessation in [[2021 Israel–Palestine crisis|violence between Palestine and Israel]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/26/qatar-pledges-500-million-to-gaza-reconstruction (Al Jazeera)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2021 San Jose shooting]]
**Nine people are killed by a gunman during a [[mass shooting]] at a [[Santa Clara Valley Transportation Authority]] [[rail yard]] in [[San Jose, California]]. The perpetrator commits suicide at the scene. It is the California Bay area's deadliest mass shooting since 1993. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-us-canada-57260869 (BBC News)] [https://www.mercurynews.com/2021/05/26/active-shooter-response-underway-near-san-jose-vta-light-rail-yard/ (The Mercury News)]
*''[[Milieudefensie et al v Royal Dutch Shell]]''
**In a landmark case, [[The Hague]] district court orders [[Royal Dutch Shell]] to cut its [[Greenhouse gas emissions|carbon emission]]s to 45% of its 2019 emission levels. This is the first time that a company has been legally forced to uphold the obligations laid out in the [[Paris agreement]]. A spokesperson for Shell states that the company will appeal the decision. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-57257982 (BBC News)]
*[[Hillsborough disaster]]
**[[William Davis (judge)|Mr Justice William Davis]] of the [[High Court of Justice|High Court of Justice of England and Wales]] dismisses the cases against two retired [[South Yorkshire Police]] officers and a lawyer of [[Perverting the course of justice|fabricating police statements]] on the 1989 disaster at [[Hillsborough Stadium]] in [[Sheffield]], [[South Yorkshire]], England, after Davis found that they had no case to answer. [https://www.dailyunion.com/sports/judge-ends-trial-of-3-accused-after-hillsborough-disaster/article_4c8bc4f5-768a-54b4-aa2e-4d46700f70eb.html (''Daily Jefferson County Union'')]
*Former [[South African President]] [[Jacob Zuma]] pleads not guilty to multiple [[criminal charge|charges]], including [[corruption in South Africa|corruption]], fraud, [[racketeering]] and [[money laundering]], relating to a [[United States dollar|$]]2 billion arms deal in 1999. Zuma said that the charges were politically motivated by a rival section of the ruling [[African National Congress]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/safricas-ex-president-zuma-appears-court-corruption-plea-2021-05-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Iraq]]i security forces arrest Qasim Muslih, a senior commander in the [[Popular Mobilization Forces]] and head of the [[Al Anbar Governorate|Anbar]] faction, for his role in the recent assaults on [[Al Asad Airbase]] and the killing of two civil activists. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/26/iraq-militia-commander-arrested-under-anti-terrorism-law (Al Jazeera)]
*Lawmakers in [[Afghanistan]]'s [[Wolesi Jirga]], the lower house of [[National Assembly (Afghanistan)|Parliament]], have accused the [[Ministry of Finance (Afghanistan)|Ministry of Finance]] of hiding the names of people accused of embezzling $8 million per day, or $3 billion annually, from customs. The acting minister of finance did not deny the claims but did say that there are reports of corruption involving governors, police commanders, and employees of the Ministry of Finance as well as ordinary citizens. [https://tolonews.com/index.php/afghanistan-172411 (TOLO News)]
* Jan Graffius, the curator of the [[Libraries and collections of Stonyhurst College|Stonyhurst Collections]] states that the theft of the gold rosary that [[Mary, Queen of Scots]] took to her execution is a “very tragic loss” for Catholic history. Thieves broke into [[Arundel Castle]] in [[West Sussex]], southern England, stealing the [[Rosary|rosary]] and other items worth more than $1.4 million. [https://www.catholicnewsagency.com/news/247789/theft-of-mary-queen-of-scots-rosary-a-tragic-loss-for-catholic-history (Catholic News Agency)]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[2021 Syrian presidential election]]
**[[Syrians]] head to the polls to elect their [[President of Syria|President]]. [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2021/5/26/syrian-presidential-election-kicks-off-amid-international-outcry (Al Jazeera)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[May 2021 lunar eclipse]]
**A total [[lunar eclipse]] occurs, the second-shortest of the [[List of future astronomical events|21st century]], with totality lasting for only 14 minutes. Nicknamed the ''[[Supermoon|Super]] Flower Blood Moon'', the eclipse was visible over the Pacific Ocean and [[Oceania]], with [[South Asia|South]] and [[East Asia]] seeing the eclipse at moonrise, and the [[Americas]] seeing the eclipse at moonset. [https://www.space.com/super-flower-blood-moon-2021-thrills-stargazers/ (Space.com)]
*The [[Galápagos National Park]] in [[Ecuador]] confirms that a female tortoise discovered by scientists two years ago is a [[Fernandina Island Galápagos tortoise]], following recent genetic tests performed at [[Yale University]]. Prior to this rediscovery, the species was thought to have been extinct for over a century. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2021/may/26/galapagos-giant-tortoise-found-species-considered-extinct (''The Guardian'')]

'''Sports'''
*[[2020–21 UEFA Europa League]]
**In [[association football]], [[Villarreal CF|Villarreal]] win their first [[UEFA Europa League|Europa League]] title and first major trophy in the club's 98-year history, after defeating [[Manchester United F.C.|Manchester United]] on [[Penalty shoot-out (association football)|penalties]] in the [[2021 UEFA Europa League Final|final]] at the [[Stadion Miejski (Gdańsk)|Stadion Miejski]] in [[Gdańsk]], Poland, which ended in a 1–1 draw after [[Overtime (sports)#Association football|extra time]]. [https://news.abs-cbn.com/sports/05/27/21/football-villarreal-edge-man-utd-in-epic-shootout-to-win-europa-league (ABS-CBN News)]
